description: This file appears to be a shell script that contains test cases for the 'git send-pack' command, testing its behavior with references sent over stdin and command line, verifying ref updates, and handling refspecs and mirror options.

methods.name: create_ref
methods.description: Creates and updates a git reference with the provided name and commit derived from the input argument.

methods.name: clear_remote
methods.description: Removes any existing remote.git directory and initializes a new bare git repository.

methods.name: verify_push
methods.description: Verifies that a given git reference has been properly pushed by comparing the expected and actual revisions.
